cases.independent_core_check: Let B=|b|², C=|c|², q=b·c>0, S=B+C+2q=|b+c|². The answer's k,m,F formulas simplify to F=(C b+B c)/S. For circumcenter O of ABC with A=0, O·b=B/2 and O·c=C/2. Consequently F·F=BC/S=O·F, so |2F|²-2O·(2F)=0. This verifies the claimed endpoint from the answer's own exact F formula without using any private source. Moreover 0<k,m<1/2, k+m-1<0; F has positive barycentric coefficients C/S and B/S summing to less than 1, so the vector branch is nondegenerate and interior.
